catchup.why_summary: Why am I seeing these posts?
catchup.why_intro: Each post scores on signals this instance already holds, and the score halves as the post ages. Nothing is fetched from anywhere else, and nothing learns from what you open:
catchup.weight.booster: per account you follow who boosted it
catchup.weight.favourites: × log of the favourites seen from here
catchup.weight.boosts: × log of the boosts seen from here
catchup.weight.replies: × log of the replies seen from here
catchup.weight.emoji: × log of the emoji reactions seen from here
catchup.weight.author: you favourited, boosted or replied to this author in the last month
catchup.weight.thread: continues a conversation you took part in
catchup.weight.half_life: the score halves for every this many hours since the post reached your feed
catchup.why_rules: Your own posts, and anything you already favourited, bookmarked, boosted or replied to, are left out. At most two posts per author. Twenty entries, then the page ends: there is nothing more to scroll.
catchup.why_boosts_hidden: You have boosts hidden, so boosts from the accounts you follow are not counted here either.
catchup.why_privacy: Your blocks, mutes and filters apply exactly as on every other timeline.
